# Centerspace Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date


Company Release -


10/01/2026


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


MINNEAPOLIS


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Centerspace (NYSE: CSR) (the "Company") will release its operating results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Monday, November 2, 2026.


Due to the Company's previously announced merger with Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), the Company will not host a conference call regarding its third quarter 2026 operating results.


**About Centerspace**
*Centerspace is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. Founded in 1970, as of September 30, 2026, Centerspace owned 47 apartment communities consisting of 10,456 homes located in Colorado, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah. Centerspace was named a Top Workplace in 2026 by USA Today and for the seventh consecutive year in 2026 by the Minnesota Star Tribune. For more information, please visit*[www.centerspacehomes.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788258-1&h=2696788115&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centerspacehomes.com%2F&a=www.centerspacehomes.com) *.*


If you would like more information about this topic, please contact Justin Ziegler, Investor Relations, at (952) 401-6600 orir@centerspacehomes.com .
